abstract: Malignant germ cell tumors are relatively uncommon, accounting for approximately 3% of all childhood malignancies. Occurring with an incidence of approximately 4 per million among children less than 15 years of age, they account for approximately 225 new cases per year in the United States. Germ cell tumors occur in both gonadal and extragonadal sites, with extragonadal and testicular tumors predominating in children less than 3 years of age and with the gonads being the main location of tumors during and after puberty. They occur more frequently in girls than boys. Germ cell tumors are interesting for several reasons: (1) abnormal migration of primordial germ cells account for many of the childhood germ cell tumors; (2) markers exist to allow evaluation of the extent of resection and the development of recurrence for many of the tumors; and (3) the introduction of platinum-based chemotherapy has markedly improved the survival rate for germ cell tumors, as well as the salvage rate for recurrent or metastatic disease.
abstract_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍は比較的稀で、小児悪性腫瘍の約3%を占める。15歳未満の小児における発生率は約100万人あたり4人であり、米国では年間約225例の新規症例に相当する。胚細胞腫瘍は性腺および性腺外の部位に発生し、3歳未満の小児では性腺外および精巣の腫瘍が多く、思春期以降は性腺が主な発生部位となる。女児に男児より多く発生する。胚細胞腫瘍には、次のような点で興味深い特徴がある。(1)小児の胚細胞腫瘍の多くは、始原生殖細胞の異常な移動に起因する。(2)多くの腫瘍では、切除範囲の評価や再発の発生を評価するためのマーカーが存在する。(3)白金製剤ベースの化学療法の導入により、胚細胞腫瘍の生存率が著しく改善し、再発性または転移性疾患の救済率も向上した。
